svg.title: Buy the Interest, Verify the Decimal, Reconcile the Cash
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-01-title-to-cash-workflow; chart type: process_flow; title: Buy the Interest, Verify the Decimal, Reconcile the Cash; subtitle: Five operating steps from recorded ownership to royalty receipts.; chapter number: 1; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Scope covers private oil and gas mineral interests and nonparticipating royalty interests. NMA means net mineral acres; NPRI means nonparticipating royalty interest. Instruments and state law control ownership, executive rights, and allocation. The typical first-deal window is 6–24 months.; caption: A tract description, an operator pay decimal, and a seller's acreage claim are different evidence objects. Reconcile them before pricing the interest.; stages: label: Define the acquired property interest precisely; value: Map tract, instrument, estate, and seller; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Record county, legal description, recording references, seller vesting, and whether the asset conveys minerals, a lease-dependent royalty, or an NPRI. Do not substitute surface acreage for the severed mineral estate.; label: Reconstruct title and calculate economic ownership; value: Resolve reservations before accepting ownership decimals; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Use county recorder instruments and a landman's run sheet to trace conveyances, probate, liens, and reservations. Calculate NMA from supported fractional mineral ownership; read fixed and floating NPRI language before applying any lease royalty multiplier.; label: Underwrite production and development evidence separately; value: Stress price, decline, deductions, and timing; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Match operator statements to state well identifiers and production records. Model realized commodity prices, decline curves, post-production deductions, and downtime. Treat undrilled locations and pooling-docket developments as contingent cases rather than current royalty cash.; label: Acquire through documented closing and recordation; value: Transfer verified rights with tracked basis; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Counsel verifies the conveyance and required releases; the landman confirms recording and operator transfer requirements. Track purchase basis and transaction costs by interest, with cash release tied to documented closing conditions.; label: Reconcile royalties and package realized exits; value: Recognize royalties plus gains, excluding returned basis; numeric value: 5.0; detail: Use Python csv and sqlite3 to match statements, production months, ownership decimals, deductions, and bank deposits. Investigate suspense and missing payments; for sales, separate returned carrying basis from realized rights-trading gains.

rect.title: label: Define the acquired property interest precisely; value: Map tract, instrument, estate, and seller; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Record county, legal description, recording references, seller vesting, and whether the asset conveys minerals, a lease-dependent royalty, or an NPRI. Do not substitute surface acreage for the severed mineral estate.

text.title: Define the acquired property interest precisely

Record county, legal description, recording references, seller vesting, and whether the asset conveys minerals, a lease-dependent royalty, or an NPRI. Do not substitute surface acreage for the severed mineral estate.

rect.title: label: Reconstruct title and calculate economic ownership; value: Resolve reservations before accepting ownership decimals; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Use county recorder instruments and a landman's run sheet to trace conveyances, probate, liens, and reservations. Calculate NMA from supported fractional mineral ownership; read fixed and floating NPRI language before applying any lease royalty multiplier.

text.title: Reconstruct title and calculate economic ownership

Use county recorder instruments and a landman's run sheet to trace conveyances, probate, liens, and reservations. Calculate NMA from supported fractional mineral ownership; read fixed and floating NPRI language before applying any lease royalty multiplier.

rect.title: label: Underwrite production and development evidence separately; value: Stress price, decline, deductions, and timing; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Match operator statements to state well identifiers and production records. Model realized commodity prices, decline curves, post-production deductions, and downtime. Treat undrilled locations and pooling-docket developments as contingent cases rather than current royalty cash.

text.title: Underwrite production and development evidence separately

Match operator statements to state well identifiers and production records. Model realized commodity prices, decline curves, post-production deductions, and downtime. Treat undrilled locations and pooling-docket developments as contingent cases rather than current royalty cash.

rect.title: label: Acquire through documented closing and recordation; value: Transfer verified rights with tracked basis; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Counsel verifies the conveyance and required releases; the landman confirms recording and operator transfer requirements. Track purchase basis and transaction costs by interest, with cash release tied to documented closing conditions.

text.title: Acquire through documented closing and recordation

Counsel verifies the conveyance and required releases; the landman confirms recording and operator transfer requirements. Track purchase basis and transaction costs by interest, with cash release tied to documented closing conditions.

rect.title: label: Reconcile royalties and package realized exits; value: Recognize royalties plus gains, excluding returned basis; numeric value: 5.0; detail: Use Python csv and sqlite3 to match statements, production months, ownership decimals, deductions, and bank deposits. Investigate suspense and missing payments; for sales, separate returned carrying basis from realized rights-trading gains.

text.title: Reconcile royalties and package realized exits

Use Python csv and sqlite3 to match statements, production months, ownership decimals, deductions, and bank deposits. Investigate suspense and missing payments; for sales, separate returned carrying basis from realized rights-trading gains.

Assumptions: Scope covers private oil and gas mineral interests and nonparticipating royalty interests. NMA means net mineral acres; NPRI means nonparticipating royalty interest. Instruments and state law control ownership, executive rights, and allocation. The typical first-deal window is 6–24 months.
